title: Traffic-constrained probe synthesizer and lineage-aware rollback governor
author: Priya Raman
release_notes: Adds a traffic-constrained probe synthesizer that generates lineage-tagged synthetic probes and a lineage-aware rollback governor to group regressions by causal lineage; improves canary precision for multi-tenant traffic shapes.
description:
Motivation: We frequently see noisy canary signals when rollout traffic mixes multiple feature lineages (A/B flags, routing keys, tenant shapes). Existing single-stream probes can conflate independent regressions and cause unnecessary rollbacks. This PR introduces two coordinated pieces: 1) a probe synthesizer that emits traffic-constrained, workload-shaped probes with lineage metadata (span tags + synthetic request fingerprint) so regressions can be attributed to causal traffic slices; and 2) a lineage-aware rollback governor that aggregates detection signals along lineage groups and applies conservative gating/partial rollback policies before invoking full rollback.

What this PR does (high level): - Adds src/canary/probe_synthesizer.py: generates synthetic probe cohorts by replaying sampled production traces, scaling QPS and shape parameters, and tagging each probe with lineage identifiers derived from routing keys, feature flags, and tenant IDs. The synthesizer supports pluggable shaping profiles (burst, steady, spike) and emits traces to the canary pipeline. - Adds src/canary/rollback_governor.py: consumes detection events and lineage tags, performs causal clustering, computes a lineage-consensus score, and maps score -> action (no-op / partial throttle / canary pause / rollback). Policies are configurable per-service via canary config. - Adds integration tests under tests/integration/test_lineage_grouping.py that validate clustering and staged rollback flows. - Adds perf tests under tests/perf/test_probe_shapes.py that assert sensitivity and false-positive rates across three shaping profiles. - Adds metrics and tracing: canary.probe.lineage.*, canary.governor.action.* and Opentracing tags for lineage_key and probe_profile. - Minimal docs update at docs/canary/lineage-rollout-guards.md describing the new knobs and example configs.

Design notes: - Lineage is derived as a deterministic hash of (routing_key, feature_flag_set, tenant_bucket) to avoid PII in tags. - The governor computes consensus by combining percentile deltas, SLO-weighted severity, and probe cohort size; thresholds implement hysteresis to avoid flip-flopping during transient noise. - Probe Synthesizer is implemented to run in the canary worker pool; it reuses the existing traffic-synth interface and keeps resource overhead modest by defaulting to low-QPS cohorts.
